intro.text: Brightlord Kaves Kholin, a distant Kholin relative and lesser lord in Kholinar with ambitions beyond his modest power.

items.text: Kaves had little real power in Kholinar but kept trying to increase his influence, which annoyed the royal branch of the family. There was little love between them.

When the city was besieged, Kaves went to the palace with several attendants to seek an audience with Queen Aesudan. She had them seized and executed, and their bodies were left in a wine cellar. Shallan found them while sneaking into the palace, and Adolin and Elhokar guessed that one was Kaves, though they grieved little.
